description: Browse and manage contact persons within partner organizations. Central hub for managing individual contacts, their roles, and communication details.

pages.name: ContactListComponent
pages.description: This page serves as the central hub for viewing, searching, and managing all contact persons associated with partner organizations. Users can browse contact details, create new contacts, import contacts in bulk, and initiate business card scans. It provides a comprehensive overview of all contacts in the system.

buttons.label: New Contact | Edit Contact
buttons.description: Opens a dialog to create a new contact or modify an existing one. This is where you input all the essential details for a contact person, including their name, email, job title, and the partner organization they belong to.
when_to_use: When you need to add a brand new contact person to the system.
When you need to update the details of an existing contact, such as their job title, contact information, or associated partner.
When you've identified a new key individual within a partner organization.

buttons.label: Scan Business Card
buttons.description: Activates the business card scanner interface, allowing you to capture and extract contact information directly from a physical business card using AI. This feature automates data entry and reduces manual effort.
when_to_use: When you have a physical business card from a new contact and want to quickly add their details to the system.
To save time and minimize errors during contact creation from external sources like networking events.

buttons.label: Import Contacts
buttons.description: Opens a dedicated dialog to import multiple contacts simultaneously from external files, such as Google Sheets or CSV files. This is an efficient way to add a large number of contacts at once.
when_to_use: When you have a large list of contacts in a spreadsheet that you need to add to the system.
For migrating contact data from another system or a legacy file into the current platform.
When onboarding a new partner with many associated contacts.

tabs.name: Details
tabs.label: title.details
tabs.description: Displays the core information of the contact, including personal details, contact information, and the associated partner organization. This is the primary view for a contact's profile.

tabs.name: Interactions
tabs.label: title.interactions
tabs.description: Shows a chronological log of all interactions and communications related to this specific contact, such as meetings, phone calls, emails, or other touchpoints. This provides a history of engagement.

search.description: Enables users to quickly locate specific contacts within the list by searching across various fields such as name, email, and associated partner organization.
search.help_text: Type a contact's first name, last name, email address, or the name of their partner organization to find them. The search is case-insensitive and will display matching results as you type.

help_guidance.when_stuck: If you're having trouble finding a contact, use the search bar at the top of the list. To add new contacts, click the 'New Contact' button. If you need to narrow down your view, check for available filters (though none are explicitly listed on this page, they might be available in future updates or contextually).
common_tasks: Finding a contact: Use the search bar at the top of the list and type in the contact's name, email, or the name of their partner organization.
Creating a new contact: Click the 'New Contact' button. Fill in the required details in the dialog that appears and save.
Editing an existing contact: Click on a contact's row in the list to open their details page, then click the 'Edit Contact' button.
Scanning a business card: Click the 'Scan Business Card' button to use the AI-powered scanner to quickly add new contacts.
Importing multiple contacts: Click the 'Import Contacts' button to open the import dialog and upload contacts from a Google Sheet or CSV file.
troubleshooting: Problem: Cannot create or edit a contact → Solution: Ensure you have the necessary permissions. If the 'New Contact' or 'Edit Contact' buttons are disabled or missing, contact your system administrator.

Problem: Search results are not accurate or complete → Solution: Try using different keywords or check for typos. Ensure the contact information is correctly entered in the system. If the issue persists, contact support.
help_guidance.getting_started: Welcome to the Contact Management page! To begin, you can search for existing contacts using the search bar, or add a new contact by clicking the 'New Contact' button. If you have a physical business card, try the 'Scan Business Card' feature for quick data entry. For bulk additions, use the 'Import Contacts' option.
